Component: OCI image aggregate
Version: platform-specific release lock
License: NOASSERTION (aggregate; see each image and package)

The offline OCI archive contains multiple applications, base distributions and transitive OS
packages under different licenses. Application-level notices alone are insufficient. For every
platform-specific archive, retain the immutable image/manifest digests, image configuration,
package inventory, SBOM, all image-provided license directories, and required source/source-offer
material. Review copyleft packages, including Forgejo and Git, before distribution.
